get.description: The non-secret configuration a page needs before sign-in: the Turnstile site key.

Server-sent events for a signed-in account: what changed on the pages its permissions cover (an admin's, every page, and the server's log as it is written). The game's events need the Game page, and a draw reaches it at once, with the winners. The account is checked again every heartbeat and whenever an account changes: one deactivated or deleted, whose password changed or whose session ended has its stream ended, and one that lost a permission stops hearing what it covered. An account with no permission has nothing to follow (403). Send Last-Event-ID when reopening to resume; read the state shown again on every open, since the stream carries only what changes.

parameters.description: The id of the last event this client got, sent when it reopens the stream: the events since it that the account may hear come first. One the server no longer keeps is answered with resync.
parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

schema.description: The id of the last event this client got, sent when it reopens the stream: the events since it that the account may hear come first. One the server no longer keeps is answered with resync.

get.description: Anyone may read it. Staff with the Game page see every number, the winners and the half-time prompt at once; anyone else sees the numbers players have got (each after its draw delay), no winners and no prompt. Since it differs by who asks, it is never cached.

patch.description: The draw delay, the details, the It's Yoever reaction and the automatic draws: only what is sent. Each change is heard with its value: the delay by the Game and Settings pages (draw_delay), the details and the reaction by everyone (game_details, yoever_switched), the automatic draws by the Game page (auto_draw). Answers the game.

post.description: From the columns the game's patterns use. It takes over from the automatic draws, which stop. Staff hear it at once and the boards after its delay (draw); a new winner stops the automatic draws, and reaching half-time prompts the consoles (halftime_prompt). No game running, or every number drawn, is refused (409).

In one with logging the winners staff confirmed. Everyone hears it ended (game_ended), and the staff with the Winners Log page that the log changed (resource_changed). A game ended while another has started since is refused (409).

Once per game: every console hears it was answered, and by whom (halftime_resolved), and closes its prompt. A mini-game reaches the boards once the number that reached half-time has (minigame). An answer for a game no longer running, a second answer, or one before half-time is refused (409). Answers the game.
Every console and board hears of it on its live stream (game_started). A game already running is refused (409) unless the start says to replace it.

From a player's board: the boards and the Game page hear it, with the player's name (yoever). A card waits the settings' yoeverCooldownSeconds between reactions (429, with Retry-After). An unknown card is a 404, the reaction switched off a 403, and no game running a 409.
